source: SYNTHETIC test data for the unit tests. Every id, title, date, post id and line of text here is fictional; none is a real memory, Draft or Facebook post.

memories.title: The Lighthouse Postcard
memories.lead: For as long as anyone could remember, a postcard of a lighthouse leaned against the clock on the shelf by the door.

memories.title: The Pocket Watch That Ran Slow
memories.lead: Every morning the pocket watch ran four minutes slow, and nobody in the house ever thought to fix it.

memories.title: Lemon Cake on Tuesdays
memories.lead: There was always lemon cake on Tuesdays, whether or not anyone had asked for it.

memories.title: The Garden Gate
memories.lead: The garden gate squeaked so loudly that the whole street knew whenever someone came home late.

memories.title: Letters on a Snow Day
memories.lead: On the first snow day of the year, the kitchen table disappeared under a pile of unfinished letters.

memories.title: A Calm and Bright Evening
memories.lead: May your evening be calm and bright.
